items.title: Stanley Kay interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001
items.q: But Nat Pierce, I got Nat Pierce the job in the band.

ctx.x: Which band was this now? Shorty Sherock?

Shorty Sherock was a great trumpet player. He played with Horace Heidt. But Nat Pierce, I got Nat Pierce the job in the band. All right? But after that Buddy called me. And the way I joined the band, I get into town and I go to his suite and he said the first set was seven o’clock, because you played for dancing then. And I remember all the guys that were in the band I could tell you their names. So he said, “go down and play the first set.” He didn’t take me down. So I walked up to the bandstand, and the guys…
Wow. Let me take you back for a moment. I have two questions. First of all you were a young boy during the depression?
